snippet.title: Bake.gg - Bakery Game Discord Bot
snippet.description:
It’s time to create the bakery of your dreams! On Bake.gg, you’ll be able to experience the life of a professional baker as you go help design, prepare and serve the most exquisite pastry in town!

Learn more here: https://bake.gg/
